matchConditions.name: native-v1-manager
matchConditions.expression: has(object.metadata.labels) && object.metadata.name.matches('^instance-manager-[a-f0-9]{32}$') && 'longhorn.io/component' in object.metadata.labels && object.metadata.labels['longhorn.io/component'] == 'instance-manager' && 'longhorn.io/instance-manager-type' in object.metadata.labels && object.metadata.labels['longhorn.io/instance-manager-type'] == 'aio' && 'longhorn.io/data-engine' in object.metadata.labels && object.metadata.labels['longhorn.io/data-engine'] == 'v1' && 'longhorn.io/managed-by' in object.metadata.labels && object.metadata.labels['longhorn.io/managed-by'] == 'longhorn-manager'

matchConditions.name: instance-manager-owner
matchConditions.expression: has(object.metadata.ownerReferences) && size(object.metadata.ownerReferences) == 1 && object.metadata.ownerReferences.all(o, o.apiVersion == 'longhorn.io/v1beta2' && o.kind == 'InstanceManager' && o.name == object.metadata.name && o.uid.matches('^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$') && has(o.controller) && o.controller)

matchConditions.name: approved-privileged-container
matchConditions.expression: object.spec.restartPolicy == 'Never' && (!has(object.spec.initContainers) || size(object.spec.initContainers) == 0) && size(object.spec.containers) == 1 && object.spec.containers.all(c, c.name == 'instance-manager' && c.image == 'ghcr.io/devantler-tech/platform-longhorn-instance-manager@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa' && has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.privileged) && c.securityContext.privileged && !has(c.securityContext.runAsUser) && !has(c.securityContext.runAsGroup) && (!has(c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot) || !c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot))
